content_text:
Hi Roger and everyone on the forum,
I started making a little educational YouTube series. These are fun little projects I do to try to convey certain lighting/physics concepts that I think are important.
They feature cartoons, miniatures, action, absurdity, and comedy. I spend a hell of a long time on them haha… I love it.
This one is about the INVERSE SQUARE LAW:
INVERSE SQUARE LAW FT. PHOTON PHIL
—
This one is about wrapping light sources:
COVE LIGHTING EXTRAVAGANZA
If any of you take the time to check these out, I would be ecstatic. It is made for a small niche audience of course 🙂
If you are going to watch any of them, I recommend watching the
INVERSE SQUARE LAW
one since it is particularity manic and insane.
A lot of these concepts are things I originally became aware of because of this forum and the generosity of everyone here. So thank you 🙂
www.mattbendocinema.com
